title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-20 12:50:16 最新章节：第九十四章 恶魔
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
那一年，师太不会和和尚抢老道。那一年，人们也不会蛋疼。那一年，杯具只是用来刷牙。那一年，肚子大了知道是谁的
放学了！
他终于从学校大解放了出来，死气沉沉进学校，生龙活虎走出来！
"火影……似乎又要更新了呢……"林凡喃喃着！
他是个动漫迷！也是同人小说迷！他喜欢在看同人小说！
回到家里，便是打开网页开始看《火影忍者》连载！可却在此时，电脑突然一闪，蓝屏了！
"这是怎么回事？"林枫愣住了！电脑居然蓝屏了，这什么烂电脑？接着电脑灯光全部熄灭！电灯熄灭！
停电？
要不要这么倒霉？
林枫无语了！而接下来，林枫感觉脑袋昏昏沉沉，顿时一片黑暗........有没有这么倒霉啊！
火影世界，木叶村，此刻，虽然深夜，但是整个木叶村上下灯火通明，人声吵杂，如同闹市。
无它，木叶天才，金色闪光的第一个孩子要出世了。
人声鼎沸之中，一个一脸威严的青年在医院的回道之中徘徊走动，不时望向紧闭的大门。
这青年正是波风水门。
木叶三忍之一自来也的亲传弟子，猿飞日斩的徒孙。他具有"木叶的金色闪光"的荣誉称号，尤擅长时空间忍术"飞雷神"，开发了形态变化的究极模式--螺旋丸，并以速度闻名，享誉忍者世界。
此刻波风水门很是紧张，无缘无故，没有怀孕前任何征兆，漩涡玖辛奈就要生孩子，这让他既紧张又兴奋。
同时觉得这件事情很不简单！
波风水门正自徘徊走动，突然，天空毫无征兆地狂风呼啸起来，一团团墨云涌现，将圆月覆盖，同时，墨云之中一道道血色雷电闪烁翻滚，以医院上空为中心瞬间扩散至整个天下。
波风水门不由与五大国之中的所有忍者目瞪口呆地看着天空异象。
这是？波风水门眉头一皱，脸色凝重。

雷电狂暴，突然，随即月亮闪现了一下，接着，消失，此与同时，雷电消失，墨云退去，一切回恢正常。
波风水门惊呆地看着天空变化，一时没有反应。
难道是幻觉？
不仅是波风水门，忍者五大国千万忍者都闪过这个念头，毕竟刚才从雷电闪烁到光芒出现，后一切恢复，只不过是几个眨眼功夫。
“水门大人，水门大人，小少爷出生了！”就这时，一个医疗忍者快步走了过来，对波风水门施了一礼，高兴道。
“生了！”波风水门一愕，接着一喜，转首急冲冲跑了进去。
此时林枫睁开眼睛。
这是哪里？他环视四周时，觉得不对劲，看了看自己，不由一呆，这，这，自己竟然变成了婴儿？
林枫一时呆滞，一会之后，被一阵脚步和吵杂声拉回现实。
content_en:
That year, the master would not compete with the monk for the master. That year, people wouldn’t be in pain. That year, cups were only used for brushing teeth. That year, I got pregnant and knew whose belly it was.
School is out!
He was finally liberated from the school. He entered the school lifelessly and came out full of life!
"Hokage... seems to be updated again..." Lin Fan murmured!
He is an anime fan! Also a fan fiction fan! He loves reading fan fiction!
When I got home, I opened the web page and started watching the series of "Naruto"! But at this moment, the computer suddenly flashed and had a blue screen!
"What's going on?" Lin Feng was stunned! The computer actually has a blue screen. What kind of crappy computer is this? Then all the computer lights went out! The lights go out!
power failure?
Do you want to be so unlucky?
Lin Feng was speechless! And then, Lin Feng felt his head was dizzy, and suddenly it was dark... Could he be so unlucky?
Naruto World, Konoha Village, at this moment, although it is late at night, the entire Konoha Village is brightly lit and noisy, like a busy city.
Without it, Konoha's genius, the golden shining first child was about to be born.
Amid the bustle of people, a young man with a majestic face wandered around the corridors of the hospital, looking at the closed door from time to time.
This young man is Minato Namikaze.
The direct disciple of Jiraiya, one of the Sannin of Konoha, and the disciple of Hiruzen Sarutobi. He has the honorary title of "Konoha's Golden Flash" and is especially good at the time and space ninjutsu "Flying Thunder God". He developed the ultimate mode of form change - the Rasengan. He is famous for his speed and is well-known in the ninja world.
At this moment, Namikaze Minato was very nervous. For no reason, and without any signs of pregnancy, Uzumaki Kushina was about to give birth to a baby, which made him both nervous and excited.
At the same time, I feel that this matter is not simple!
Namikaze Minato was wandering around when suddenly, a violent wind roared in the sky without warning, and groups of ink clouds emerged, covering the full moon. At the same time, blood-colored thunder and lightning flashed and rolled in the ink clouds, centering above the hospital, and instantly spread to the entire world.
Namikaze Minato couldn't help but stare at the strange phenomenon in the sky with all the ninjas in the five major countries.
This is? Namikaze Minato frowned, his face serious.
Thunder and lightning were violent, suddenly, and then the moon flashed for a moment, and then disappeared. At the same time, the thunder and lightning disappeared, the ink cloud receded, and everything returned to normal.
Namikaze Minato watched the changes in the sky in shock, without reacting for a moment.
Is it an illusion?
Not only Namikaze Minato, but also millions of ninjas from the five major ninja countries have had this thought. After all, from the flash of thunder and lightning to the appearance of light, and then everything restored, it was just a few blinks of an eye.
"Minato-sama, Minato-sama, the young master is born!" At this moment, a medical ninja walked over quickly, bowed to Namikaze Minato, and said happily.
"Give birth!" Namikaze Minato was shocked, then overjoyed, turned around and hurried in.
At this time Lin Feng opened his eyes.
Where is this? When he looked around, he felt something was wrong. He looked at himself and couldn't help but be stunned. This, this, he turned into a baby?
Lin Feng was stunned for a moment, and after a while, he was brought back to reality by footsteps and noise.
